// Test-only native inputs. Loaded exclusively by the guarded private overlay.
package main

import (
    "context"
    "fmt"
    "os"
    "path/filepath"
    "strings"
    "sync"
    "time"

    "github.com/shirou/gopsutil/v4/cpu"
    "github.com/shirou/gopsutil/v4/disk"
    "github.com/shirou/gopsutil/v4/host"
    "github.com/shirou/gopsutil/v4/load"
    "github.com/shirou/gopsutil/v4/mem"
    "github.com/shirou/gopsutil/v4/net"
)

var statusFixtureRoot string
var statusFixtureHome string
var statusFixtureStarted time.Time
var statusFixtureTraceMu sync.Mutex

func init() {
    root, token := os.Getenv("MOLE_TEST_RUN_ROOT"), os.Getenv("MOLE_TEST_BOUNDARY_TOKEN")
    physical, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(root)
    recorded, readErr := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, ".test-boundary"))
    home := os.Getenv("HOME")
    physicalHome, homeErr := filepath.EvalSymlinks(home)
    if err != nil || readErr != nil || homeErr != nil || physicalHome != home ||
        !strings.HasPrefix(home, root + string(os.PathSeparator)) || root == "/" || physical != root || token == "" ||
        os.Getenv("MOLE_TEST_SANDBOX_ACTIVE") != token || strings.TrimSpace(string(recorded)) != token {
        fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "status native fixture refused: private sandbox boundary required")
        os.Exit(16)
    }
    statusFixtureRoot, statusFixtureHome, statusFixtureStarted = root, home, time.Now()
    runCmd = statusFixtureCommand
    commandExists = func(name string) bool {
        switch name {
        case "pmset", "ioreg", "system_profiler", "diskutil":
            return true
        default:
            return false
        }
    }
    cpuCountsFunc = func(bool) (int, error) { return 2, nil }
    cpuLoadFunc = func() (*load.AvgStat, error) { return &load.AvgStat{Load1: 1.5, Load5: 1, Load15: .5}, nil }
    cpuTimesFunc = func(bool) ([]cpu.TimesStat, error) {
        elapsed := time.Since(statusFixtureStarted).Seconds()
        return []cpu.TimesStat{
            {CPU: "cpu0", User: elapsed * .25, Idle: elapsed * .75},
            {CPU: "cpu1", User: elapsed * .25, Idle: elapsed * .75},
        }, nil
    }
    diskPartitionsFunc = func(bool) ([]disk.PartitionStat, error) {
        return []disk.PartitionStat{{Device: "/dev/disk0s1", Mountpoint: "/fixture", Fstype: "hfs"}}, nil
    }
    diskUsageFunc = func(path string) (*disk.UsageStat, error) {
        if path != "/fixture" { return nil, fmt.Errorf("unexpected fixture disk path %q", path) }
        return &disk.UsageStat{Path: path, Total: 8 << 30, Used: 2 << 30, Free: 6 << 30, UsedPercent: 25}, nil
    }
    diskIOCountersFunc = func(...string) (map[string]disk.IOCountersStat, error) {
        elapsed := time.Since(statusFixtureStarted).Seconds()
        return map[string]disk.IOCountersStat{"fixture": {Name: "fixture", ReadBytes: uint64(elapsed * (1 << 20)), WriteBytes: uint64(elapsed * (1 << 19))}}, nil
    }
    ioCountersFunc = func(bool) ([]net.IOCountersStat, error) {
        elapsed := time.Since(statusFixtureStarted).Seconds()
        return []net.IOCountersStat{{Name: "fixture0", BytesRecv: uint64(elapsed * (1 << 20)), BytesSent: uint64(elapsed * (1 << 19))}}, nil
    }
}

func statusFixtureHostInfo() (*host.InfoStat, error) {
    return &host.InfoStat{Hostname: "mole-private-cli-fixture", Platform: "darwin", PlatformVersion: "fixture", Uptime: 3600, Procs: 1}, nil
}

func statusFixtureMemory() (*mem.VirtualMemoryStat, error) {
    return &mem.VirtualMemoryStat{Total: 1 << 30, Used: 1 << 29, Available: 1 << 29, UsedPercent: 50, Cached: 1 << 20}, nil
}

func statusFixtureSwap() (*mem.SwapMemoryStat, error) { return &mem.SwapMemoryStat{}, nil }

func statusFixtureInterfaces() ([]net.InterfaceStat, error) {
    return []net.InterfaceStat{{Name: "fixture0", Addrs: []net.InterfaceAddr{{Addr: "192.0.2.1/24"}}}}, nil
}

func statusFixtureCommand(ctx context.Context, name string, args ...string) (string, error) {
    if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil { return "", err }
    key := name + " " + strings.Join(args, " ")
    statusFixtureTraceMu.Lock()
    trace, err := os.OpenFile(filepath.Join(statusFixtureRoot, "status-provider-trace"), os.O_APPEND|os.O_CREATE|os.O_WRONLY, 0600)
    if err == nil { _, err = fmt.Fprintln(trace, key); closeErr := trace.Close(); if err == nil { err = closeErr } }
    statusFixtureTraceMu.Unlock()
    if err != nil { return "", err }
    if name == "ps" {
        if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(statusFixtureHome, "status-provider-failure")); err == nil {
            return "", fmt.Errorf("intentional status fixture ps failure")
        } else if !os.IsNotExist(err) { return "", err }
    }
    switch key {
    case "ps -Aceo pid=,ppid=,state=,pcpu=,pmem=,rss=,comm= -r":
        return "101 1 S 12.5 3.125 32768 FixtureWorker\n", nil
    case "ps aux":
        return "USER PID %CPU %MEM VSZ RSS TT STAT STARTED TIME COMMAND\nfixture 101 12.5 3.125 65536 32768 ?? S 12:00 0:00 FixtureWorker\n", nil
    case "sysctl -n hw.perflevel0.logicalcpu hw.perflevel1.logicalcpu":
        return "2\n0\n", nil
    case "memory_pressure ":
        return "System-wide memory free percentage: normal\n", nil
    case "pmset -g batt":
        return "Now drawing from 'Battery Power'\n -InternalBattery-0 75%; discharging; 2:00 remaining present: true\n", nil
    case "ioreg -rn AppleSmartBattery":
        return "\"CycleCount\" = 30\n\"DesignCapacity\" = 100\n\"NominalChargeCapacity\" = 90\n\"Temperature\" = 3000\n", nil
    case "system_profiler SPPowerDataType -json":
        return `{"SPPowerDataType":[]}`, nil
    case "system_profiler SPPowerDataType":
        return "Condition: Normal\n", nil
    case "system_profiler SPHardwareDataType":
        return "Model Name: Fixture Mac\nChip: Fixture CPU\n", nil
    case "system_profiler -detailLevel mini SPDisplaysDataType":
        return "Refresh Rate: 60 Hz\n", nil
    case "system_profiler -json SPDisplaysDataType":
        return `{"SPDisplaysDataType":[{"_name":"Fixture GPU","sppci_cores":"2"}]}`, nil
    case "system_profiler SPBluetoothDataType":
        return "Bluetooth:\n", nil
    case "sw_vers -productVersion":
        return "fixture\n", nil
    case "powermetrics --samplers gpu_power -i 500 -n 1":
        return "GPU HW active residency: 12.00%\n", nil
    case "diskutil info disk0":
        return "Internal: Yes\nSMART Status: Verified\n", nil
    case "diskutil info -plist /fixture":
        return `<?xml version="1.0"?><plist version="1.0"><dict><key>TotalSize</key><integer>8589934592</integer></dict></plist>`, nil
    case "scutil --proxy":
        return "<dictionary> {}\n", nil
    default:
        _ = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(statusFixtureHome, "status-provider-unsupported"), []byte(key), 0600)
        return "", fmt.Errorf("unsupported status native fixture command: %s", key)
    }
}
